creation_strategy.rule: Migration lookups do not establish creation provenance; creation requires its own exact creation-signature lookup contract.

pilot.selection: one unresolved-slot signature plus nine deterministic mint-sorted retained-slot signatures
stop_conditions: attempt to retain raw transaction data

provider_budget.compute_unit_cost: UNVERIFIED; bind to the selected RPC account before authorization
provider_budget.limits: Do not assume Birdeye 20/4 market-data limits apply to RPC; require an explicit isolated RPC budget.

retained_slot_assessment.interpretation: Mint/signature/slot agreement is retained locally, but timestamp disagreement and absent raw transaction semantics prevent independent migration-event qualification.

acceptance: derived pool/transition evidence is internally consistent
fail_closed: timestamp disagreement is retained, never overwritten
missing migration event semantics is not promoted
